facts: FPCR is a64-bit control register. RMode23:22 encodes00 RN,01 RP,10 RM,11 RZ.
The MRS Xt,FPCR access pseudocode assigns FPCR() to the general-purpose destination on the successful access path.
AHP bit26=0 selects IEEE half format. The observed rawzero also leaves FZ24 and FZ16 19 clear; no general subnormal conformance claim is inferred.

records.short_quote: the number with an even least significant digit
facts: For finite representable-range values, RN picks the nearest destination number; equidistant bracketing numbers resolve to the even least significant digit.
The rounding mode is selected by FPCR.RMode or the instruction; instructions with fixed or alternate modes must be considered separately.

records.short_quote: using the current rounding mode as specified by FPCR.RMode
facts: Scalar floating-point precision conversion FCVT uses the current FPCR.RMode. This is distinct from the named float-to-integer instructions with fixed rounding.
The function accepts an FPCR value, unpacks the operand, and handles NaN, zero, infinity and negative cases separately.
On the ordinary positive path N=32 selects prec26, invokes SqrtRounded(value,prec), then FPRound32(value,fpcr).
This source reading identifies the architectural dependency and does not independently prove the hardware conformance or reconstruct every nested pseudocode helper.
